description: Menu entry rules shared by the Runic Desktop menu bar (DesktopHostOptions.MenuBar, Runic.Desktop.Tests) and status icon menus (DesktopStatusIconState.Menu, Runic.Platform.Runtime.Tests). A title is literal text: not blank, at most 128 characters, no NUL. A command id has 1 to 64 ASCII letters, digits, dots, underscores or hyphens and does not start with the reserved 'runic.' in any letter case. A command parameter is at most 1024 characters without NUL. An access key is one letter or digit. A radio group name follows the command id rule, and a radio item needs IsChecked. Status icon menus keep each pair of command id and command parameter unique (a missing parameter differs from an empty one). A value {"repeat": s, "count": n} stands for s repeated n times.
